pattern.short_summary: The user's freehand mark — a stroke, a scribble, an arrow, a drawn layout — is taken as input to generation, either alongside or in place of a written prompt.
pattern.definition: The user's freehand mark — a stroke, a scribble, an arrow, a drawn layout — is taken as input to generation, either alongside or in place of a written prompt. The mark's geometry and its position carry specification, not merely selection. Each drawing pass conditions the next generated result, so drawing is the steering channel.
pattern.structural_signature: A drawing surface captures freehand vector input; the captured strokes are passed to the generator as conditioning signal; the generated result is returned into or beside the same surface so it can be drawn on again. The stroke's shape and placement are consumed as content, so two different strokes in the same location yield different results.

dimension.category_description: How users, artifacts, examples, parameters, or user-state signals specify intent and shape the system's next behavior.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a user-facing specification or adaptive interaction; invisible sensing infrastructure is excluded.
